goal: Treat World messages containing WTB + taxi/T A X I + a recognized destination as buyer summon requests, so examples such as 'WTB Hydraxian taxi' enter the normal SummonScout invite path without weakening destination, blacklist, dedupe or seller guards.
notes: Small Lua-only parser hotfix in the existing explicit-API roster/world guard. The guard recognizes only the narrow buyer pattern WTB + taxi (including spaced T A X I) when Engine V2 resolves a known destination, then routes that message through the existing core as a summon request. Existing configured-service destination gating remains authoritative, so wrong-destination requests are still blocked. No native Ritual, payment, advert, coordinator or DLL behavior is changed.
